testCase.name: [本地] S24 Human review: the task screen matches the prototype minus Email Tasks, and Email Tasks is gone as functionality, not just hidden

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S24 「人工审查：任务界面和原型一致（去掉 Email Tasks），而且 Email Tasks 是作为功能被去掉的，不只是藏起来」 Human review: the task screen matches the prototype minus Email Tasks, and Email Tasks is gone as functionality, not just hidden

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Design and functionality match the source-of-truth prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, except Email Tasks (AC 11 and the 2026-09-24 comment win)（TFA-92585 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U7 The task list can be sent to another signed-in app user (an NP or covering physician) in-app only, through the Handoff delivery (same recipient picker, same in-app delivery), never by email（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (TFA-92585 attachment, 2026-09-25), the app's task screens, the task screens' code (TasksOverlay, routes/snf/Tasks, tasksExport, handoffs send), convex/email.ts and the built bundle

When Compare layout, grouping, labels, completed section and Copy Text output side by side; review what Copy Text and Send can call; watch network requests while pressing them

Then Matches the prototype; the prototype's Email Tasks is absent in the app (AC 11 wins); Send, the visit on completed tasks and the completed grouping are judged against the AC text and the current app UI (Q13). No mailto, email-send action, Web Share or Capacitor Share is reachable from the task screens; convex/email.ts only sends sign-in codes; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side review (AC 1) and code + HAR review (AC 11 'confirmed absent, not just unused')

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92585 ready for pr；TFA-92586 ready for pr

Email Tasks 确实删干净了（只有 Copy Text，任务没有任何发邮件的路径），但任务页上没有 Send 按钮，没法把清单发给接班医生。

Email Tasks is really gone (only Copy Text, and no email path for tasks), but the task screen has no Send button for handing the list to a covering physician.

依据：code-review partial. The code half passes: the only mailto is the Settings support link, and email carries only sign-in codes. Send lives in PR #106 (not merged), with TFA-92585 and 92586 both ready for pr. Q13 (Daniela) decides whether Send is judged against the current UI. The p72 side-by-side and the HAR capture were not run.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local (source and bundle) / both (HAR while pressing Copy/Send on dev) 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S24

Human review: the task screen matches the prototype minus Email Tasks, and Email Tasks is gone as functionality, not just hidden

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr); TFA-92586 Handoff Summary: in app (ready for pr)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status partial → 待人看（部分：能查的这半通过，另一半要别的 lane / 人 / 文件 → 待人看）。

Detail:

Both task routes render the same component. /rounding/tasks uses TasksOverlay directly, and /snf/tasks (routes/snf/Tasks.tsx) wraps it with today's residents. The only control in the header is "⎘ Copy Text"; the source has no 'Email Tasks' control, and a comment says the mail button was removed on Sep 24. copyTasks builds plain text with buildPendingTasksText, which does no I/O. It writes that text through copyTextToClipboard (the browser clipboard or @capacitor/clipboard), falls back to execCommand('copy'), and logs the export through the app's own Convex mutation api.access.logExport. Ticking a task off calls api.rounding.update or api.snf.update.

A source-wide grep finds no navigator.share, no @capacitor/share and no 'Email Tasks'. The only mailto: is the Support link in SettingsModal, which is not on the task screens; the static bundle grep likewise finds one mailto: in the bundle.

convex/email.ts sendEmail has two callers:
- emailOtpAuth.deliverSignInOtp, which rejects every code type other than 'sign-in'.
- The generated sendResetPassword in auth_provider_extension. auth.ts spreads emailOtpAuthOptions after it, which sets emailAndPassword to { enabled: false } and disables the reset-password paths, so that caller can't be reached.

So email only carries sign-in codes, and the code-decidable part of the scenario passes.

Note for the Q13 / U7 half: the task screen has no Send button at all. Neither TasksOverlay nor the SNF route offers sending the task list to another signed-in user through Handoff delivery. That is for the person judging Send against the AC text (Q13). It doesn't affect this question's rule.

和 Then 不一致（againstThen）：

  • apps/web/src/components/TasksOverlay.tsx:249: The task screen has no Send control that hands the task list to another signed-in user through Handoff delivery. The header holds only the Copy Text button, so U7's Send is not present on this screen. A person decides this against the AC text (Q13).
  • apps/web/src/features/handoff/SendHandoffModal.tsx:33: The task screen has no Send button. Sending a handoff is offered only by SendHandoffModal in the handoff feature, so U7's in-app sending of the task list is not available from TasksOverlay. This is for the person judging Send under Q13.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • U7 / Q13: the task screen has no Send button for handing the task list to an NP or covering physician through Handoff delivery. The person reviewing Send against the AC text needs to confirm whether that is acceptable or whether it is a gap.
  • The question's pass rule mentions 'Send' calling only the app's backend, but there is no Send on the task screens, so that part passes only because nothing is there to call.
  • The Then names 'Send' from the task screens, but TasksOverlay has no Send control. Whether a separate Send on the task screen is required (U7) or the Handoff screen is enough is for the Q13 reviewer to decide.
  • The scenario lists no open questions, yet the Then refers to Q13. This verdict leaves that half to the person reviewing it.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • side-by-side vs p72 (VISUAL (a person signs off))
  • Send / completed tasks vs AC text (Q13) (a person, Q13)
  • HAR while pressing Copy/Send (PW)
  • Visual side-by-side match with RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (layout, grouping, labels, completed section)
  • Whether the missing task-screen Send and the completed-task grouping meet the AC text (Q13, person)
  • HAR capture while pressing Copy Text or Send (PW lane)
  • Visual match of layout, labels and grouping with p72 (person sign-off).
  • The HAR capture while pressing Copy/Send (PW lane).
  • Whether the built bundle's single mailto: hit (assets/index-*.js) is only the Settings support link. The source grep points that way, but the bundle offset was not checked.

审查结论（verdict）：pass

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
